<!-- FAQ Section -->
<div class="section section-gray">
<div class="container">

<h2 class="section-title">Frequently <span>Asked</span></h2>

<div class="grid-2">

<div class="feature-card">
<h3>Is the programme module included in every plan?</h3>
<p>Yes. Every plan includes the programme module with Gantt, critical path, baselines, the programme assistant with voice input, import from MS Project, Asta or Primavera, and export for MS Project or Primavera. The plan sets how many programmes, baselines, imports and assistant requests you get: Free includes 1 programme of up to 150 tasks, Essential 10 programmes, and Professional and Scale unlimited programmes, each of up to 2,000 tasks.</p>
</div>

<div class="feature-card">
<h3>Is there a free plan?</h3>
<p>Yes. The Free plan gives you 3 projects, 1 team member and the programme module with 1 programme of up to 150 tasks. Upgrade any time as your needs grow.</p>
</div>

<div class="feature-card">
<h3>How does the free trial work?</h3>
<p>Essential and Professional start with a 30-day free trial, and no credit card is needed. Scale starts through our sales team. If the trial ends without payment, your account falls back to the Free plan limits. Nothing is deleted.</p>
</div>

<div class="feature-card">
<h3>Are there any per-user fees?</h3>
<p>No. Each plan includes a set number of team members, and the Scale plan includes unlimited team members. No hidden per-seat charges.</p>
</div>

<div class="feature-card">
<h3>How does the price compare with per-user programme licences?</h3>
<p>Praevius charges one monthly price per company, not a licence for each user. Each plan includes a set number of team members: 1 on Free, 3 on Essential, 10 on Professional and unlimited on Scale. Adding a planner, site manager or QS to the team costs nothing extra until you reach the plan limit. Many scheduling tools are licensed per user, so compare the total cost for your whole team with the plan that fits.</p>
</div>

<div class="feature-card">
<h3>Can I change plans later?</h3>
<p>Yes. Change your plan anytime from the Billing page. If you cancel, your plan stays active until the end of the billing period, and you can reactivate it before that date.</p>
</div>

<div class="feature-card">
<h3>Is annual billing available?</h3>
<p>Yes. Annual billing available at a lower price.</p>
</div>

<div class="feature-card">
<h3>What integrations are included?</h3>
<p>Essential includes Google Drive Sync, SharePoint Document Sync and one accounting integration: Xero Invoicing, QuickBooks Online or Sage Intacct. Professional and Scale include all three accounting integrations. Scale adds Procore ↔ SharePoint Sync and Schedule of Values.</p>
</div>

<div class="feature-card">
<h3>What is Agent Access?</h3>
<p>Agent Access connects your own AI agent to the Praevius MCP server. Agent access is available over MCP with OAuth sign-in; read on every plan, write actions need Professional or Scale and your confirmation.</p>
</div>

<div class="feature-card">
<h3>What's included in support?</h3>
<p>Every plan includes email support at support@praevius.app.</p>
</div>

</div>

</div>
</div>
